QuestInfo.name: Aramia's Golden Maple Leaf
QuestInfo.0: A shiny gold colored Maple Leaf has fallen off a fully grown Maple Tree. Bring it to #p9000055# who is in charge of the Maple Tree.
QuestInfo.1: Take the Golden Maple Leaf to #p9000055# who is in charge of the Maple Tree.
QuestInfo.2: When you brought a Goldem Maple Leaf, that fell off a fully grown Maple Tree, to #p9000055#, the Maple Tree caretaker, said that the Golden Maple Leaf can be used as a seedling for a Maple Tree and gave you a gift as your reward.
